title: CasV1
description: A cell-set-level annotation collection shaped after the Cell Annotation Schema (CAS, general + BICAN) with local extensions. The module (cxg-author-probe) emits the STRUCTURAL skeleton from a dataset (labelsets + per-cell-set annotations with counts + hierarchy + data provenance); downstream consumers progressively enrich the same doc with ontology mappings (composition/cell_ontology_term_id), report fields (rationale/markers), and atlas-paper 'source'. Local extensions: per-cell-set 'composition' (cell-set-level generalisation of CxG cell-level descriptor fields), cell_count/cell_ratio on transferred annotations, labelset 'rank'/'role', and an optional 'source' block carrying atlas-paper provenance for a report workflow.

matrix_file_id.description: Resolvable target for the cell-by-gene matrix: URL or filename of the h5ad/zarr the annotations describe. Looser than CAS's namespace:accession form so a plain zarr/h5ad URL or path is valid.

data_provenance.description: Where the annotations were extracted from (the dataset). Filled by the producing module.

source.description: Optional local extension: atlas-paper provenance (DOI, subatlas papers) consumed by a downstream report workflow. Not part of CAS core and not produced by the module.

labelsets.description: Annotation keys. One labelset per cell-type obs column.

annotations.description: Per-cell-set annotations, each tied to a labelset + cell_label.

Labelset.description: A CAS labelset (annotation key). Local extension adds 'role'.

name.description: Name of the annotation key (obs column).

role.description: Local extension: functional role. Free text (open) with recommended values; drives routing, not enumerated as a hard constraint.

Annotation.description: One annotated cell set. Closed set (additionalProperties:false) — arbitrary obs goes in author_annotation_fields, descriptor distributions in composition.

labelset.description: Name of the labelset this annotation belongs to.

cell_label.description: Verbatim author label for the cell set.

cell_set_accession.description: Stable id for this cell set, independent of cell_label.

parent_cell_set_accession.description: Accession of the cell set that subsumes this one (hierarchy).

n_cells.description: Local extension: number of cells in the set.

transferred_annotations.description: CAS slot reused for integration provenance (author labels inherited from contributing datasets).

composition.description: Local extension: cell-set-level distributions over descriptor categories.

author_annotation_fields.description: Arbitrary UNMAPPED obs fields, verbatim. Must not duplicate a labelset or a composition category.

TransferredAnnotation.description: A label transferred from another source. CAS-BICAN shape; local extension adds cell_count/cell_ratio. Reused for integration provenance.

source_taxonomy.description: PURL/DOI of the source taxonomy or contributing study.

cell_count.description: Local extension: cells in this set carrying the transferred label.

cell_ratio.description: Local extension: fraction of the set carrying the transferred label.

Composition.description: Keyed by CxG descriptor category (tissue, development_stage, assay, disease, sex, self_reported_ethnicity, organism) or an open semantic key for non-CxG descriptors. Keys are not enumerated; each value is a CompositionCategory.

CompositionCategory.description: The distribution of one descriptor category over the cell set.

author_field_name.description: The original obs column this category came from.

CompositionValue.description: One value in a descriptor distribution. 'author_value' is verbatim; 'value'/'ontology_term_id' are additive mapped forms.

author_value.description: Verbatim author value (may already be a CURIE).

ontology_term_id.description: Mapped ontology CURIE, e.g. UBERON:0000966, HsapDv:0000048.

AtlasPaper.description: Atlas publication provenance (optional local block; filled by a downstream report workflow).
